producer_report.summary: I moved the Transport items from gh/mod.rs into gh/transport.rs verbatim and re-exported them from mod.rs, so paths like crate::gh::Runner are unchanged. The one visibility change is the private clock_entropy, now pub(super) so mod.rs can still call it. I also added a CHANGELOG entry saying there is no behavior change. I did not run the full suite or diff the `--list` output against the base commit. Those are left to the verifier.

criteria_check.criterion: gh/transport.rs holds the Transport-row items; their text matches the text removed from gh/mod.rs apart from visibility and use lines, visible in git diff.
criteria_check.evidence: transport.rs is the removed text copied; the only change is clock_entropy becoming pub(super), plus a module doc and use lines. get_args and HOST stay in mod.rs because the row's item list omits them.

criteria_check.criterion: gh/mod.rs declares the transport module and re-exports every moved item, so existing paths such as crate::gh::Runner remain valid.
criteria_check.evidence: mod.rs has `mod transport;` and `pub use transport::{...}` for the 11 public items, plus a private `use transport::clock_entropy` for the one caller in mod.rs. cargo clippy --all-targets compiles all crates.

criteria_check.criterion: A Grep the verifier runs shows no file outside crates/athena-core/src/gh/ names a moved item by an old module path (e.g. gh::transport::X where it was gh::X).
criteria_check.evidence: The module is private and nothing outside gh/ was edited, so no outside file can name gh::transport. Workspace builds, clippy included.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing test code is unchanged except for import lines, visible in git diff.
criteria_check.evidence: Only 2 test-module use lines were added in mod.rs (RefCell, and HostError with MessageClass).

criteria_check.criterion: Run cargo test --locked -- --list on the base commit and on the change: the outputs are identical.
criteria_check.evidence: No test sat in the moved region and no test was added or renamed. 75 gh:: tests ran under their old names. I did not diff the full --list output.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings and cargo test --locked all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran fmt and clippy clean and the gh:: and external_calls_guard tests; I did not run the full suite.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for G2 stating no behavior change.
criteria_check.evidence: A G2 entry sits at the top of the Unreleased Changed section and says "No behavior change".

criteria_check.criterion: No criterion rests on the producer's report; all checks are runnable by the verifier.
criteria_check.evidence: Every check above is a command or a git diff the verifier can run itself.

mistakes: The first compile failed because the test modules needed RefCell, HostError and MessageClass imports. I fixed it.
learnings: Test modules in gh/mod.rs use `use super::*` and a few parent imports, so removing imports from the parent broke their build. I fixed that with test import lines.
The Transport row range 36-374 also covers HOST and get_args, but the row's item list omits them, so they stay in mod.rs.
